svg.title: Strobe Assistant - ALB and target groups
svg.text: Strobe Assistant — one ALB, three target groups
How agent.example.com fans out to the three Fargate services. Solid: request traffic. Dashed grey: ALB health checks.
ACM certificate · TLS ends here, wss works
the 300 s idle timeout keeps long turns open.
Caller is the agent task, not the browser
(see the dashed path at the top).
Agent → MCP calls re-enter the ALB: mcp-url (Parameter Store) = https://agent.example.com/mcp → /mcp* rule
Fargate uses awsvpc networking: each task gets
its own network interface and private IP, and
there is no EC2 instance to register.
Who keeps each group’s target list current
Each ECS service is linked to its target group
(container name + port). ECS registers a new
task’s IP on start, drains and removes it on stop.
Why an ALB in front (not API Gateway)
One HTTPS name for three services, path routing,
and WebSocket upgrades on /acp with a 300 s
idle timeout for long streamed turns.
